description: This file defines a class DoTokenParser within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'do' tags in Twig templates. It evaluates an expression and discards the result, aiding template processing.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser\DoTokenParser
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'do' tags and creating DoNode instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'do' tag in a Twig template, evaluates the contained expression, and returns a DoNode with the expression and line number.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'do', identifying this parser for 'do' tags.
